name: POND'S Light Moisturiser 100ml Non-Oily Fresh Feel For Soft Glowing Skin With Vitamin E & Glycerin
description:
POND'S Light Moisturiser – 100ml

Non-Oily Fresh Feel | Soft & Glowing Skin | With Vitamin E & Glycerin
Country of Origin: India

Key Features:

Lightweight & non-oily formula – Instantly absorbs into skin without leaving a greasy feel

24-hour moisture lock – Provides long-lasting hydration for soft, supple skin

Fresh & glowing skin – Leaves skin nourished with a natural, healthy glow

Vitamin E enriched – Protects skin from environmental damage with antioxidant care

Glycerin powered – Retains moisture to keep skin hydrated, smooth, and radiant

Year-round use – Suitable for all seasons, including hot and humid weather

Multi-purpose care – Perfect for face, hands, and body

Benefits:

Hydrates dry skin effectively

Nourishes & protects with Vitamin E

Lightweight, fast-absorbing & non-greasy

Ideal for all skin types

Gentle fragrance for a fresh feel
